'''Gash''' was a [[Narglatch/Legends|narglatch]] that lived at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was domesticated and regarded as a loyal companion.

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Gash is a [[:w:c:cwa:Companion|companion]] for players of the online game [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']].
